text:
maya: Quick async quarterly milestone sweep — 2-min updates please. For each area (runtime / console / dedicated) say: shipped or slipped, owner, blocker (if any), next step. I’ll compile for the exec summary.

sam: Runtime — shipped kv-cache v2 :ship:. Canary at 50% with no regressions so far. Owner: sam/priya. Blocker: none in canary, still watching seq-length edgecases. Next step: full rollout Friday, will post rollout window.

priya: Runtime — slip on beam-aggregator E2E. Tests flaky under burst seq lengths, root cause looks like batching timeout + race. Owner: priya + sam. Blocker: repro on CI infra. Next step: add targeted stress test and increase batching timeout; aiming to stabilize by next Tue. Need infra help to repro load.

jules: I can provision a dedicated test pool Wed morning (4 G4dn nodes) to reproduce. Reserved nodes for Wed 09:00-12:00 PT. Also note infra PR #4123 (test harness tweaks) needs CR before Wed — tagging @ava.

ava: On PR #4123 now :eyes:. Hope to get review in by EOD. SRE will run synthetic load after CR.

deploy-bot: canary status — kv-cache-v2 reached 50% at 1764156000; no rollbacks detected.

sam: Console — shipped feature flags gating new rollout :ship:. UI changes live behind flag; analytics events wired. Owner: sam + maya. Blocker: i18n strings missing for fr/es. Next step: schedule translation pass and enable flag for 10% traffic next Wed.

maya: Translation priority = medium, target next week. We can delay full enable if i18n not ready.

priya: Dedicated capacity — small slip. Autoscaler edge-case when burst + reserved capacity leads to transient throttles under sustained 95th percentile load. Owner: priya. Blocker: needs config tweak + canary. Next step: apply config change in staging and run 2h soak.

jules: Will coordinate canary for dedicated after runtime full rollout. Suggest doing dedicated canary Thu to avoid overlap.

sam: Quick CR pings: @ava please review #4123, @maya please ack console i18n priority, @jules confirm Thu canary window.

ava: CR done, left 2 small nits, pushing fixes now.

jules: Confirmed Thu 14:00-16:00 PT window for dedicated canary.

maya: Thanks — consolidated notes for exec: runtime shipped (kv-cache v2) but beam-aggregator tests slipped (mitigation in flight); console flags shipped but i18n pending; dedicated autoscaler tweak slipped to Thu canary. Owners and next steps above. I’ll send a one-pager.

priya: One more note — reproducer command for infra: ```k8s-batch-run --pool=reserved-test --nodes=4 --duration=2h --seq-dist=heavy``` — use to simulate burst seq-length traffic.

sam: If anyone needs me for rollouts ping in #eng-runtime; will post final rollout playbook tomorrow. :thumbsup:
